description.en: Create advanced automations with Remote commands, background entity state-change triggers, metadata-driven device commands, conditional sequences, nested branches, waits, delays, HTTP requests, and automatic entity refresh. Runs directly on Remote Two/3 or as an external integration.

value.en: Run Advanced Automations directly on this Remote or as an external service. Open the web interface on port 8099, configure a Remote Core API key, then create command-driven or background state-change automations. Generated commands and touchscreen pages refresh automatically after changes.
